scope: Independent exact original-command/topology/georeferencing review of Mraissa own-map area only. This is not a whole-cohort import approval or a new claim of authoritative GIS source intent.

exactIdentityForFutureProposal.identityEvidenceScope: Own-map title and electoral-sector layer personally viewed; code/name linkage follows the pinned author source/registry review. This independent review does not redo the original INS workbook or statutory electoral-to-imada identity audit.

independentChecks.originalStreamOperators: Exactly two m/l.../S paths at operations 5467–6491 and 6492–6968; no fill operation, inserted join, implicit close segment, or transformed source path.
independentChecks.onlyRingOrderDifference: Independent GeoJSON reverses both rings for outer CCW / inner CW winding; coordinate values and edges are exact.

area.qualification: Projected and ellipsoidal area numbers differ normally because they use different measurement surfaces; the geographic vertex coordinates are identical.

registration.qualification: The 0.276 m control-fit residual is registration consistency, not survey accuracy or a tolerance allowing source geometry repair.

visualSourceReview.titleAndLegend: The own-map title names the Mraissa electoral district; the legend identifies red electoral-district/imada boundaries, blue delegation boundaries and black governorate boundaries.
visualSourceReview.sourceOverlayOnly: Administrative vector commands are inspected; no geometry is extracted from the Google satellite basemap or its incidental labels.
visualSourceReview.smallLoopQualification: The small loop falls under thick overdraw in the rendered map. Original vector commands prove its mathematical presence; the rendered crop does not independently certify that a 111.53 m² hole was an intentional surveyed exclusion.

sourceMeaningDecision.recommendation: The explicitly qualified finite-area interpretation is defensible for the next source-proposal and cohort-impact review. No further source is necessary merely to resolve this exact closed walk into its area component.
sourceMeaningDecision.reason: The own-map administrative linework forms one exact closed walk with no proper crossings. Its one exterior and one opposite-winding touching interior cycle determine the same area under both conventional winding rules. Every area-boundary edge and vertex is already present in the source; only zero-area reverse excursions are represented separately.
sourceMeaningDecision.mandatoryQualification: The PDF strokes two open paths and never fills a region. This proposal is a derived boundary-area interpretation, not a claim that ISIE exported this valid Polygon, explicitly specified a fill rule, or certified survey-level accuracy.
sourceMeaningDecision.outsideSpur: Original edges 1116 and 1117 make a ~10.56 m outward-and-back line excursion with exactly zero enclosed area. The area Polygon omits that one-dimensional support; it is retained in the original linework/edge-partition evidence. Claiming complete equality of the polygon boundary to every original stroked segment would be false.
sourceMeaningDecision.whenAdditionalSourceIsNeeded: If the requirement is to certify the publisher’s intended treatment of the tiny loop/spurs or an authoritative surveyed administrative vector, obtain the original ISIE/OTC/CNCT/Interior GIS source for code 156151. This review cannot elevate a stroke-only map into that stronger claim.

preservationContractForAnyLaterStage.acceptedAreaCoordinates: Use either pinned proposal geometry exactly; only cyclic start position and complete ring reversal may change serialization. No added/deleted nonzero-area edge, smoothing, snapping, buffering, clipping, make_valid or hole filling.
preservationContractForAnyLaterStage.coordinatePipeline: Preserve all selected coordinates from the pinned prior held WGS84 line; original decimal edge identity and the float32 page-to-UTM-to-WGS84 pipeline remain documented.
preservationContractForAnyLaterStage.wholeMapArea: No cropping to the old OSM boundary or neighboring candidate polygons.
preservationContractForAnyLaterStage.cohortGate: Before import, independently assess complete adjacent-sector topology and finite current source/raw/picker/default consequences. This report authorizes no isolated replacement, locality deletion, point relocation, name merge or prayer-reference change.
preservationContractForAnyLaterStage.generationGate: Any eventual packed serialization must retain the hole, its one-vertex contact and valid area topology; compare the exact finite effects. This source review has not run generation or that packed audit.

reviewExecution.firstAttempt: review_original_region.py stopped before proposal/facts creation because the PDF GCS embeds WKT without an EPSG key. Original script retained.
reviewExecution.operativeAttempt: review_original_region_v2.py resolves EPSG from the unchanged embedded WKT; all original topology/coordinate guards retained.
